# R317 — Official pristine v0.1.43 parameter-selection audit

Date: 2026-10-13 (JST). Read-only review of official pristine Strata v0.1.43 source pinned at `7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d`, current committed update reports, and prior parameter/safety audits. No Git commands, builds, tests, imports, model/runtime/GPU work, cleanup, or source edits were performed. No model input below 32K is proposed or considered.

## Finding

The retained v0.1.43 B570 long-prompt measurements do **not** demonstrate parameter optimization. They are one-sample diagnostics, not a selected setting: the two official arms changed only requested expert-cache budget (128 vs 512), ran one 32,768-ID prompt each, had 16 generated tokens and `performance_eligible=false`. Both explicitly set `--short-read 65536`, so they took `serial_read_windows8` for the 32,767 fresh-text positions. Their literal `--prefill 8` did not mean an 8K batch and had no effect on this route. The arms also changed effective cache substantially (144/281 MiB vs 624 slots); generated IDs and LP5 differed, so even that one-axis diagnostic is not a quality-neutral optimum comparison.

This is a bounded conclusion about retained inspected evidence, not proof that no unindexed experiment ever existed. R286 records the exact official rows and qualification; R225/R299 document why the batched path is currently not safely tunable on the stated B570 host-USM capability state. Historical v0.1.40.2/v0.1.41 work repeated one requested recipe and likewise did not establish an independent pristine search (R357/R361).

## What was actually tested

Source binary provenance was the official commit above, same binary SHA `49025c6c…f3340f`, prompt hash/IDs, and environment across both cache arms (R286). Both requested:

```text
--max-context 262144 --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768 --no-kv-grow
--expert-cache <128 or 512> --expert-profile <profile> --expert-cache-per-layer
--pool-workers 5 --pcie-frac 0 --adapt-swaps 0 --suffix-draft 0 --greedy
--no-spec-split --short-read 65536 --spec 8 --prefill 8
```

No `--mtp` was supplied, so `--spec 8` was not MTP drafting. Captured environment included `STRATA_TRACE=1`, stepped verifier/device plan, validation layers, loader logging, forced Level Zero v2 adapter, and `UR_L0_V2_FORCE_DISABLE_COPY_OFFLOAD=1`; these diagnostics were instrumented and not speed-eligible. Cache128: 19.07 prefill / 6.29 decode tok/s, 144 slots/281 MiB. Cache512: 17.77 / 8.48 tok/s, 624 slots. One sample per arm; outputs/LP5 differ. Source route plus PP progress independently confirms serial window route (R286, official `generate.cpp` route predicate at lines 643–646, 800–801 and 10523–10525 in the R286 audit's source version).

Do not conflate this with the separate XeStrata Xe0.1.42 diagnostic: its summary says `batched8192`, 217.61/10.41 tok/s and 29/144 slots, but full argv/effective controls are absent (R286). It is a different inference-engine build and route, not a matched official setting arm. Likewise, local integrated settings and timings cannot establish pristine official optima.

## What setup-auto means for the stated PC

Official `setup.py` emits `--expert-cache auto --prefill auto --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5 --mtp <draft> --max-context <ctx>`; it adds `--kv <type>` above 8192 context (source lines 5572–5578). For a 10 GB card, setup's `rec_ctx` is 32768 when VRAM is below 14 GB (line 5256); actual selected context is also capped by RAM/model rules (5258–5260). Given the stated 128 GiB RAM and ordinary Qwen3.8 model selection, setup's recommendation is 32K context, subject to the user accepting that choice. It does not hard-force the recommendation where setup asks the user to choose.

At 32K, the setup-generated defaults are `--prefill auto`, cache `auto`, spec 4 plus an MTP artifact; the setup branch only enables `--kv-resident 32768` for context >=65536 (lines 5597–5628), so 32K does not activate KV streaming. A bare `--prefill auto` has a source ceiling of 8192; the engine's admission scan chooses an effective chunk subject to cache/ring memory, not a proven optimal chunk (official `generate.cpp` parser lines 1790–1798 and auto planner around 5940–6010). Setup does not write `--pool-workers`; therefore one cannot claim the explicit tested value 5 is the installer default. The engine's automatic worker policy applies unless the user config overrides it. A 5600X is six-core/12-thread, but setup does not infer “5 is best.”

Most importantly, setup-auto's 32K route is not the old tested route by definition: setup does not set `--short-read 65536` in the cited emitted args. At serve time the actual source route must be read from INFO/progress. DETAILS.md lines 817–821 explain that prompt tails up to `--short-read` are consumed through verify windows, while preceding portions use batched Prefill; the route must not be inferred from `--prefill` alone.

## Defensible single-axis path and prerequisites

No general safe batched-prefill sweep is admitted yet. R299 finds the official v0.1.43 batch route has device-written host-USM Stager completion polling and multi-chunk PLE reuse polling; a 32K prompt at 8192 chunk reaches multiple chunks. Parameter tweaks do not legalize those handoffs on the stated B570 (`usm_atomic_host_allocations=false`). The one-chunk/full-pinned source candidate is conditional and not a validated configuration: before any request, receipts must prove a full page-locked expert-source complement (no partial resident soft fallback), no Stager jobs, and the exact whole text segment fits one actual Prefill chunk. A clamp or unpinned routed miss invalidates the safety premise. Keep this path parked until such runtime/source admission exists.

The currently defensible selection axis is CPU pool workers on the safe serial window route, after the exact binary/runtime handoff qualification is satisfied. Use identical official source/build, same exact 32K+ prompt IDs, model/profile/cache/KV, context, sampling, input/output lengths and environment. Keep `--short-read 65536 --spec 8 --suffix-draft 0 --no-spec-split`, `STRATA_VERIFY_STEPPED=1`, `STRATA_VERIFY_PIPE=0`, `STRATA_VERIFY_NO_HOST=0`, `STRATA_VERIFY_DEVICE_PLAN=1`; hold cache and affinity fixed. Compare only effective worker setting `--pool-workers 0` (auto), `3`, and `5` (collapse arms resolving to same INFO count). This is a candidate selection experiment, not an instruction to run now: R225's safety gate and Main's runtime qualification must first admit the exact run. Require at least five interleaved cold-process samples per effective setting, all at >=32K input, preserve failures, record INFO workers/misses/jobs, window count, prompt/TTFT/decode separately, and require identical output/correctness and no queue/runtime faults. The window route is synchronization-safe by source reasoning but very slow (up to 4096 width-8 windows at 32K); it is not batched-prefill performance.

For a later batched chunk axis, first replace/qualify the unsafe host-marker handoffs or prove the strict one-chunk/full-pinned predicate on the exact machine. Then change only `--prefill` policy (auto vs fixed admitted chunk values) with `--short-read 0`, retain >=32K prompt, verify actual chunk/ring/cache admission and PLE/Stager behavior, and compare only correctness-passing runs. A serial-window timing must never be labeled a batched8192 result.

## Evidence reviewed

- Official source `/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/Niko1221/Strata/.worktree/bench-upstream-v0143-pristine-20261012`, pinned revision `7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d`: `setup.py:5256–5260, 5572–5578, 5597–5628`; `sycl/src/program/generate.cpp:1790–1798, 5940–6010`; `docs/DETAILS.md:817–821`.
- R286: `/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007/research-20261009/research-pristine-update-parameter-qualification-matrix-round286-v1.txt` — exact v160 official and Xe row routes/qualification.
- R225: `research-official-v0143-safe-parameter-campaign-round225-v1.txt` — safe serial-window candidate arms and gates.
- R299: `research-pristine-official-batched-setting-safety-round299-v1.txt` — batched host-USM hazards and conditional single-chunk/full-pinned caveat.
- R357/R361: `round357-official-pristine-parameter-search-coverage.txt`, `round361-historical-official-pristine-settings-search.txt` — historical repeated-recipe versus parameter search distinction.

No new measurement was made. The retained evidence supports “not demonstrated parameter-optimized”; it does not identify a best setting or claim one globally optimal configuration.
